notes: «وَ سَأَلَهُ عَمَّارٌ» : the asker is «عمار الساباطي»; the one asked is only a pronoun here.

prev1 (1070) has no written chain and passes. prev2 (1069) names the Imam («أَبَا عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ») and supplies the speaker, so the last link is taken from prev2, after the asker (rule al-Faqih, owner ruling 2).
